name: shrooms_core
description: Reads a Shrooms daemon's status and changes its settings, over the daemon's unix control socket. Exists because a ui_qml app is sandboxed and may not open a socket or read outside its own directory; this runs in its own process and can. What it may change is bounded by the socket's group and by the daemon itself: settings, meshes on and off, leaving — never who is admitted, which needs an admin key the daemon has never held (ADR-025).
